text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I'm planning a small batch edit across the runtime and kv-cache pages to fix ~10 broken internal links and normalize a couple of curl snippets. Hoping to land this today if I can get 1-2 reviewers.
Morgan: I can take a look after lunch. Rough ETA? :+1:
Alex: Thanks — aiming to open the PR around 15:30 PT. It'll be mainly sed replacements and one tiny code example tweak (see below).
Samir: If it's sed-only, I can do a fast pass. Watch out for localized pages though — we had a ja/ copy that diverged last sprint.
Anya: Heads up — localization team asked to hold changes on any /ja/ or /es/ pages unless it's a critical link. Could you list which files?
Alex: Good call. I'll exclude /ja/ and /es/ explicitly. Files in scope: /docs/runtime/cache.md, /docs/kv-cache.md, /docs/onboarding/curl-examples.md, plus a couple of internal redirect pages.
Alex: Example of the change: `s|https://old-cdn.example.com/runtime/v1|/docs/runtime|g` — single commit.
Samir: :eyes: that sed looks safe. Please include a short PR description that lists the replaced hostnames so I can grep locally.
Alex: Will do. Also adding a tiny code tweak in curl examples to switch `-s` -> `-sS` for better error visibility.
Morgan: Note for CR: check that the code sample still renders in the KB preview (table cells sometimes truncate backticks).
docs-bot: Preview build queued for branch alex/docs-batch-links — status will post when ready.
deploy-bot: Preview URL: https://preview.redwood/branches/alex/docs-batch-links — snapshot build #452.
Anya: I can sanity-check that we didn't accidentally remove translated anchors once the preview is up.
Samir: I'll do the git/ci check and a style pass (link text, trailing periods). If both of us sign off we can merge.
Alex: Awesome — I'll open the PR at 15:30 and ping here with the link. If anyone gets flagged by the codeowners ping, feel free to skip and I'll reassign.
Alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — description lists all hosts replaced and a short test plan.
Morgan: Reviewing now, will comment inline.
Samir: Quick note on the sed: add a word boundary for `runtime/v1` so we don't touch `runtime/v10` later. Suggest `\bruntime/v1\b`.
Alex: Good catch, updating the PR.
Samir: CI passed. :white_check_mark: I left two tiny comments (periods and one link text).
Anya: Preview looks clean; no translated anchors affected in the pages I spot-checked.
Morgan: Approved and left :shipit: comment.
Alex: Thank you all! I'll squash and merge in ~10m.
Alex: Merged and backfilled a short changelog entry in /docs/CHANGELOG.md.
Samir: Nice. Thanks for coordinating.
Morgan: Thanks!
Alex: If any lingering broken links pop up, ping this thread and I'll follow up.
